the use of fair value in transitional and emerging countries is not yet fully justified, as it could lead to the distortion of financial reports, especially if the fair value of assets and liabilities is based on the market value of assets and the market value is not yet available or not reliable.
the implementation of FVA in Transitional and Emerging Countries could contribute to the modernization of government accounting in these countries.
the use of fair value accounting in transitional and emerging countries is a useful tool for the development of public sector accounting reforms.

FVA has the potential to be an efficient and useful tool to improve the transparency of the government financial reports in transitional and emerging countries.
